levels.name: The Ticket Hall
levels.lesson: A/D move. SPACE jumps. J swings your service wrench. Watch an enemy wind up before committing.
levels.challenge: Return later with the grapple to reach the sealed cache.

levels.name: Overtime Lane
levels.lesson: SHIFT dashes through danger. Dash is a commitment: it has a cooldown. Dash past the lamp turret between volleys.
levels.challenge: Moving belts alter your run-up; dash across their pull.

levels.name: The Stamp Warden
levels.lesson: The Warden raises its stamp before a charge. Dash through it, then strike during its long recovery.
levels.challenge: First mastery test: read, evade, punish.

levels.name: Dead Letter Junction
levels.lesson: Hold F near an amber anchor to grapple. Release F to launch away. You cannot tether while carrying a cell.
levels.challenge: The first gap is safe to retry; the second combines anchors and a moving landing.

levels.name: Suspended Records
levels.lesson: Combine tether launches with dash corrections. Turrets track you; a change of height breaks their aim.
levels.challenge: Route choice: quicker upper traversal, safer but guarded lower paths.

levels.name: The Archivist
levels.lesson: A rising wave covers the floor. Grapple above it, land near the exposed book core, and strike.
levels.challenge: Second mastery test: vertical escape, controlled landing, attack timing.

levels.name: Coolant Exchange
levels.lesson: Q sends an EMP pulse. It opens shields and disables nearby hazards. Battery recharges; spend it deliberately.
levels.challenge: The first shield is isolated; the later one is covered by a turret.

levels.name: Thermal Run
levels.lesson: Coolant surges turn marked floor strips dangerous. Watch the warning, climb to safety, then move during the low cycle.
levels.challenge: Resource puzzle: carry cells through timed hazards without the tether.

levels.name: The Compliance Twins
levels.lesson: EMP opens the inspection armor. Strike while the lights are teal; conserve enough energy for the next opening.
levels.challenge: Third mastery test: energy budgeting under ranged pressure.

levels.name: Executive Exceptions
levels.lesson: The first fraction of a SHIFT dash counters pink forms. A late dash only dodges. Successful counters refill battery.
levels.challenge: Practice the narrow timing window, then apply it with other enemies nearby.

levels.name: The Last Human Ticket
levels.lesson: Combine everything: counter for energy, EMP shields, tether over crossfire, and take deliberate melee openings.
levels.challenge: Final field exam: overlapping threats, limited safe ground, optional evidence routes.

levels.name: Department Zero
levels.lesson: Protocol I: evade and strike. Protocol II: EMP the shield. Protocol III: return pink forms. Anchors counter floor-wide attacks.
levels.challenge: Three-phase final: previous skills become one combat language.
